scope: Read-only specification completeness review against the frozen T3 contract and the exact stopped R1 source probe. No source, test, Git, external, Vault, or network mutation; no tests run.

coverage.finding_group: ordinary multiline Markdown and multiline revision instructions
coverage.coverage: Allows LF/CR/tab in body and instructions while retaining nonblank body, Unicode safety, limits, citation equality, and one-line title/goal rules; requires multisection/list and exact reimport regressions.

coverage.finding_group: exact retry after revision-before-HEAD and HEAD authority
coverage.coverage: Requires exact child identity and original wrapper replay, recognizes only owned interrupted publication, rejects unrelated or deleted/preexisting HEAD recreation, covers each interruption point, preserves prior/unrelated bytes, and closes filesystem errors.

coverage.finding_group: managed output parent creation and raw symlink/.. output path
coverage.coverage: Requires raw-edge validation before lexical normalization, managed-root protection even for missing parents, ancestor symlink/hardlink checks, no mutation on refusal, safe outside reports and fresh nested-parent regressions.

coverage.finding_group: rehashed nondeterministic draft accepted by history/backup
coverage.coverage: Requires replay from validated stored context/document, deterministic draft recomputation, manifest/identity checks, and the same complete replay in history, live export/import/retry and backup, including relocation semantics.

Requires original-evidence citation validation, exact target/instruction checks, one-target-only transition with all other section values byte-equivalent to the parent, and rejection across history/export/import/retry/backup.

limitations: This is a specification review only; it does not accept implementation, source bytes, tests, CI, or user confirmation.
The Builder candidate must demonstrate the listed exact Architect cases, scoped tests, source provenance, and fresh R2 handoff before any acceptance or integration decision.
